questions.q_en:
Three of the following word pairs are alike in some manner and hence form a group. Which word pair does not belong to that group?

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be grouped based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word.)
questions.solution_en:
A monk works in a monastery. An author creates a book. A painter works in a gallery.

All the other pairs involve either a person and their workplace or a person and the product/output of their work. But, a restaurant is a place used by a chef and not by recipe.

A monk works in a monastery. An author creates a book. A painter works in a gallery.

All the other pairs involve either a person and their workplace or a person and the product/output of their work. But, a restaurant is a place used by a chef and not by recipe.
